official_sources.title: OS Terrain 50 Grid data technical specification

verified_facts: OS Terrain 50 grid height data is verified to 4m RMSE
OS Terrain 50 grid uses regular 50m spacing
grid data is supplied in 10km by 10km tiles
each ASCII tile has 200 by 200 pixels
height values are calculated from pixel centres
grid heights are supplied to the nearest 0.1m
GML accompanying ASCII data carries location, grid spacing and vertical-reference metadata
OSTN15 is the definitive OSGB36 to ETRS89 transformation
simple Helmert transformation is limited to roughly 3m accuracy applications
OSTN15 grid shifts use bilinear interpolation
OSGM15 supplies orthometric heights compatible with ODN on mainland Britain
OSGM15 nominal mainland geoid-model accuracy is 8mm rms
quality_effect: Use Terrain50 only as a coarse independent reference; bind samples to pixel-centre/tile metadata and definitive OSTN15/OSGM15 transforms, rejecting approximate Helmert or datum assumptions for precision promotion.
